description: A global inventory of solar photovoltaic generating units - dataset is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Lucas Kruitwagen, Kyle Story (University of Oxford). This is the data repository accompanying Kruitwagen, L., Story, K., Friedrich, J., Byers, L., Skillman, S., & Hepburn, C. (2021) A global inventory of photovoltaic solar generating units, Nature, forthcoming . This repository contains the training, cross-validation, test, and predicted data set as described in the publication. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is restricted according to the metadata; the conditions were not read. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
